sloka: वृतः शत सहस्रेण वानराणाम् तरस्विनाम् ।पथा मधुमता च आशु सेनाम् सेना पते नय ॥६-४-१०॥।।
transliteration: vṛtaḥ śata sahasreṇa vānarāṇām tarasvinām ।pathā madhumatā ca āśu senām senā pate naya ॥6-4-10॥।।

translations.english: "O Nila, the chief of the army Go fast with the army along the way which has plenty of fruits and roots, shady forests and cool water and sweet smelling honey".
